about: I'm Bernardo Ramírez, a full-stack developer with seven years of experience building and optimizing web systems, APIs, and mobile applications. I have contributed to products across aviation, retail, banking, security, and education using Java, Python, Kotlin, and TypeScript. I specialize in service integrations, decoupled system design, and taking features from definition to production. I enjoy learning, sharing technical decisions, and helping teams deliver maintainable software.
